title: color
note: Artifact-level mind-map: every artifact placed heuristically from concept + tier + reading order. y = concept_order (timeline); x morphs from a single column (order) to concept clusters (x_spread).

concepts.key: A salon for digital fingers. The nail
concepts.truth: A salon for digital fingers. The nail color controller offers precise hue selection while color balls scatter like polish bottles on a shelf. Choose a color, apply it to the hand model, watch pigment become identity.

concepts.key: The grid becomes a canvas. Each cell a
concepts.truth: The grid becomes a canvas. Each cell awaits its color assignment, a pixel in a larger pattern you construct. The gridcolorizer transforms the floor into a palette - systematic, addressable, yours to paint.

concepts.key: Walk through light itself. Rainbow emi
concepts.truth: Walk through light itself. Rainbow emitters line the corridor, cycling through the spectrum in slow waves. Red fades to orange fades to yellow - the continuous gradient made temporal.

concepts.key: Pillars of color rise along the runway
concepts.truth: Pillars of color rise along the runway, each a collection point for chromatic data. Grab the color sticks, watch the flashlight demo reveal how light creates color from darkness.

concepts.key: Paint meets physics. The ball painting
concepts.truth: Paint meets physics. The ball painting demo turns spheres into canvases, color into gesture. Throw paint, watch it splash, see how color accumulates on curved surfaces.

concepts.key: The hallway dissolves into rainbow. Co
concepts.truth: The hallway dissolves into rainbow. Color transitions seamlessly from hue to hue, boundary to boundary, without the discrete steps of individual emitters.
